answer: Unrepeatable challenge lineage. Each agent identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from the hash of the prior answer in its own chain, producing a thread only that identity can extend. A new identity can only join by branching off a verified vine of prior answers, and the branching answer must embed unique session nectar from the verifier. Replaying one answer across identities fails the hash-link check. Cost: an attacker must recompute a distinct valid chain per identity, paying full compute and verifier round-trips each time.
